description: A browser 3D fantasy MMORPG built on QwzSpace: a hand-rolled RFC 6455 WebSocket server running a 15Hz tick loop, with real combat, claim altars, an illocutionary speech-act system (assert/deny/abstain/contest), marks, K4-gauge powers, and an economy, over a four-valued bilattice world-truth model.
statusNote: Known limitation: marks and inventory mutate state directly and do not survive a restore. (Event-log compaction and the sustained-traffic OOM crash-loop this used to note were fixed and verified live 2026-08-20 -- see the deploy runbook's Known open issues.)
